title: RL for Large Reasoning Models
zhTitle: 大型推理模型的强化学习
overview: 大型推理模型的出现是现代AI中最显著的发展之一。与标准语言模型培训优化下个调值预测不同，推理聚焦RL教模型在回答前思考——在推论时间分配额外计算来探索，验证，并完善中间步骤。本节全面技术论述支撑这一范式的方法、结构和规模化法律。

blocks.originalExcerpt: Distillation vs. RL for Small Models A striking finding: distillation outperforms RL training from scratch on small models. DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B achieves higher MATH benchmark scores than a 7B model trained with GRPO directly. This suggests that:

blocks.text: • 小模型缺乏通过RL勘探发现推理战略的能力
blocks.originalExcerpt: • Small models lack the capacity to discover reasoning strategies via RL exploration

blocks.text: • 但是，他们可以学习模仿更大的模型发现的推理策略
blocks.originalExcerpt: • But they can learn to imitate reasoning strategies discovered by larger models

blocks.text: • 小型模型的瓶颈是探索，而不是代表性
blocks.originalExcerpt: • The bottleneck for small models is exploration, not representation

blocks.text: 提炼法提出了关于推理性质的重要问题:小模型是真正“合理”，还是在推理链的表面形式上是模式匹配?经验主义上，蒸馏模型对新问题类型表现出一些概括性，暗示推理策略的真正内在化，而不是纯粹的记忆化。
blocks.originalExcerpt: The distillation approach raises an important question about the nature of reasoning: is the small model truly “reasoning,” or is it pattern-matching on the surface form of reasoning chains? Empirically, distilled models show some generalization to novel problem types, suggesting genuine internalization of reasoning strategies rather than pure memorization.

o1的定义性建筑选择是使用隐藏推理符:模型产生内部思维链(称为“理性的追踪”或“思维符”)，不向用户显示。仅返回最后的答案。 此设计具有若干影响 :
blocks.originalExcerpt: The defining architectural choice of o1 is the use of hidden reasoning tokens: the model generates an internal chain-of-thought (called a “reasoning trace” or “thinking tokens”) that is not shown to the user. Only the final answer is returned. This design has several implications:

blocks.text: • 无格式限制:隐藏推理可以使用任何格式，包括抓图
blocks.originalExcerpt: • No format constraints: The hidden reasoning can use any format, including scratchpad

blocks.text: • 不reward hacking:由于用户从未看到推理，因此没有压力要求

blocks.text: ——专有保护:推理过程不暴露，防止直接模仿。
blocks.originalExcerpt: • Proprietary protection: The reasoning process is not exposed, preventing direct imitation.

blocks.text: 培训程序被描述为“使用RL进行理性分析的培训模式”， RL目标适用于完整的(隐藏推理+最终答案)序列，只奖励最终答案的质量。
blocks.originalExcerpt: The training procedure is described as “training models to reason using RL,” with the RL objective applied to the complete (hidden reasoning + final answer) sequence, rewarded only on the quality of the final answer.

o1 技术报告给出了一条清晰的 scaling law：在高难度推理任务上，增加 thinking tokens 会单调改善表现。系统用 thinking budget 控制隐藏推理 token 的最大数量；令 T 表示这一预算，经验曲线可写成趋向某个准确率上限的饱和函数。原书举例称，在 AIME 2024 上，o1 使用完整 thinking budget 时准确率约为 83%，而不扩展推理过程的 GPT-4o 约为 13%。
blocks.originalExcerpt: The o1 technical report demonstrates a clear scaling law: more thinking tokens monotonically improve performance on hard reasoning tasks. This is operationalized through a “thinking budget” parameter that controls the maximum number of hidden reasoning tokens. Let T be the thinking token budget. The empirical scaling law observed is approximately: Pass@1(T )...
